_about: The watch list. size: your size exactly as the shop labels it ('L', 'W34 L32', 'UK 10'; 'L|XL' = either). target: buy-at price. variant: colour when one listing holds several. bought: true stops tracking everywhere. role: what it is for outfits (jacket, overshirt, knit, cardigan, sweat, fleece, tee, jeans, chino, trouser, trainer, wallabee, boot, socks, underwear). fit.verdict: good | check | avoid (avoid = off-brief cut, never suggested). fit.reach: centre-back-to-cuff in cm per size. sizes.reach_cm: your own centre-back-to-wrist measurement, used to flag short sleeves.

fit.note: Blouson cut finishes at the waistband: make sure it isn't cropped above the belt on you. Uniqlo blocks bots, so check the size-chart sleeve against your reach.
Shirt-weight cord overshirt. No measurements here (bot-blocked): check the size-chart sleeve before buying.

items.name: Lee Workwear Overshirt, khaki
items.note: L sold out at Jeanstore; XL in stock if you want the longer sleeve.

fit.note: Relaxed cut in rigid 8.5oz canvas, no stretch: can look boxy. L sold out; XL adds sleeve length but also bulk at the middle.

items.name: Barbour Endurance Ripstop Overshirt, navy (Parasol Store)

fit.note: Relaxed fit, 100% cotton ripstop, cord collar. No measurements published: check the sleeve on arrival.
Regular fit. Reach (centre-back to cuff) ≈90cm in L, 92.5cm in XL; shoulders 48cm in L.
Loose cut with wide 52cm shoulders, so the sleeve is short from the seam (63cm) but reach is ≈89cm in L, 91.5cm in XL. UW's 6ft model (37in chest) wears L.

items.name: UW Wool Fleece Field Jacket, black

fit.note: Relaxed chore cut. Reach ≈90cm in L, 93cm in XL. UW's 6ft model (38in chest) wears L.
Barbour list the Ashby as a tailored (slimmer) cut. If you'll layer a knit underneath or need more sleeve, XL is the safer size.
Raglan sleeve: more reach and shoulder movement for long arms. 335g cotton loopback; can shrink up to 4%, so wash cool.
Raglan sleeve (despite the 'drop-shoulder' in the shop's URL). 335g organic cotton; wash cool, may shrink up to 4%.
No measurements available here (bot-blocked): check the size-chart sleeve against your reach.
Drop-shoulder cut in heavy 470g cotton: the boxy shape your brief rules out, and it adds bulk at the middle.
Relaxed fisherman knit; reviewers rate it true to size, 'roomy without being baggy'. Finisterre's L is for 180–185cm tall (you're 183cm). Wool/polyamide keeps the cuffs in shape.
Regular fit but short in the arm: reach ≈87.5cm in L, 90cm in XL. UW's 6ft 2in model wears L, but with a 36in chest.

items.name: Colorful Standard Tee, navy (more colours same shop)

fit.note: Relaxed unisex cut that can sit boxy; 180gsm organic cotton.

Regular fit, Supima cotton.
Cut as an athletic crew tee (closer to the body): may cling at the middle.

fit.note: Regular thigh, tapered leg, mid-rise sitting just below the waist; 1% elastane. Exactly the 'elevated straight-taper' in your brief.

fit.note: Regular thigh, tapered, sits at the waist; 27cm front rise. Soft lyocell stretch denim.
Regular thigh, tapered, sits at the waist; 27cm front rise; 1% Lycra.

items.name: CC Heavyweight Pleated Chinos, dark navy

fit.note: Tapered and pleated with a roomy 37.5cm thigh (at W32). Heavy 295g cotton, no stretch; up to 3% shrinkage, so don't size down.
Clean taper (19.5cm hem at 34) and a higher 35cm front rise, which suits the midsection, but 100% cotton with no stretch.

items.name: UW Double Pleat Pant, light olive

fit.note: Wide leg (24cm hem at 34) and loose thigh: wider than the slightly tapered line in your brief.

items.name: Oliver Spencer Morton pleated trouser, Purdon charcoal wool
items.note: Premium: only a buy at 40%+ off (archive sale).

fit.note: High rise sits at the natural waist (best for the midsection); straight leg tapering from the knee; wool with a little stretch.

items.name: Vans Skate Era Stub, fade olive/black

fit.note: Vans fit true to size. The Skate Era adds PopCush cushioning and a padded collar, so it's comfier all day than the classic Era.

items.name: Vans Skate Era Wafflecup, two-tone grey
items.note: Most versatile Era colour: goes with every bottom in the capsule.

fit.note: Wafflecup sole adds cushioning and support; Vans fit true to size.

items.note: Earthy, tonal Blazer: the least logo-loud colourway available in 10.

fit.note: Blazers are built on a narrow last: go half a size up if your feet are wide. Zoom Air heel.

items.note: Navy low Blazer at £60: UK 10 sold out, alerts if it comes back.

fit.note: Narrow Blazer last: go half a size up if your feet are wide.

items.note: Tonal grey suede Janoski, already reduced from £85.

items.name: Nike SB Zoom Janoski OG+, navy/gum (restock watch)

items.name: Nike Air Max 90 'Shadow Brown' leather (restock watch)
items.note: Full-grain tonal brown: the on-brief AM90. UK 10 sold out.

items.name: adidas Handball Spezial, olive strata/shadow olive
items.note: Samba-adjacent: tonal olive suede, gum sole. Different enough from your Sambas.

items.name: Clarks Originals Wallabee, maple suede

items.name: Clarks Originals Wallabee Boot, maple suede
